body:
Launcher trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-23; I lost two UI RED slots to it). `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- CMD ...` runs CMD from the REPOSITORY ROOT, whatever `pushd` set: the focused stage has no cwd (scripts/test-launcher.mjs:1587), and stageDirectory falls back to the root (:370-374). On Windows it also cannot resolve `npx` (a .cmd shim): "runner: executable not found: npx". For a focused vitest run use the root-relative entry point with vitest's own root:
`pushd "<worktree>" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui src/<path>.test.ts`
The full gate's UI stages set cwd "ui" themselves (:199, :217, :232). A fresh worktree also needs `pushd "<worktree>\ui" && npm ci` first.
